# form.openWaitDialog

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.10</span></div>

Open a wait dialog.

```lua
form.openWaitDialog(title, message[, progress, wakeup, close])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes | the title of the dialog |
| `message` | string | yes | the message of the dialog |
| `progress` | boolean | optional (default `true`) | adds a progress bar to the dialog |
| `wakeup` | function | yes | handler called on each loop |
| `close` | function | yes | handler called on close |

## Returns

WaitDialog

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local dialog = form.openWaitDialog({
  title = "Wait demo",
  message = "This is a first message",
  progress = true,
  wakeup = function() print("Wait Dialog wakeup ...") end,
  close = function() print("Wait Dialog close ...") end
})
dialog:message("This is a second message")
dialog:value(50)
dialog:closeAllowed(false)
dialog:close()
```
